Networking and background catalog dependencies

OkHttp 4.12.0 — Square, Inc. and contributors
https://github.com/square/okhttp/tree/parent-4.12.0
Okio 3.6.0 — Square, Inc. and contributors
https://github.com/square/okio/tree/parent-3.6.0
AndroidX WorkManager 2.11.2 and AndroidX dependencies — The Android Open Source Project
https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/work
Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines — JetBrains s.r.o. and contributors
https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines
Guava ListenableFuture — The Guava Authors
https://github.com/google/guava
JSpecify annotations — The JSpecify Authors
https://github.com/jspecify/jspecify

These libraries are distributed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
See Apache-2.0.txt. Dependency versions and SHA-256 verification records are
maintained in app/gradle.lockfile and gradle/verification-metadata.xml.
No firmware is included in these libraries or bundled by this feature.

Optional Firebase-enabled builds also contain Google measurement components,
which are not covered by the Apache-only statement above. See
firebase-analytics-NOTICE.md for their separate terms and source notices.
